notes.title: Playtest Version 8
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568604/274323b27dc18c10dd6c2ea436733838a746ec25.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Emotes[/h2][list][*][p]Emotes have been added, triggered randomly using the R key or D-Pad Right on gamepad[/p][/*][*][p]Emotes can be used in most character states (running, jumping, swimming, soaked, sitting)[/p][/*][*][p]Kiss emote[/p][/*][*][p]Wave emote[/p][/*][*][p]Thumbs Up emote[/p][/*][*][p]Clap emote[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Beach Balls[/h2][list][*][p]Characters can now jump on top of a beach ball and roll around on land or water[/p][/*][*][p]Spraying beach balls with the water cannon while riding lets you move very fast[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Chairs[/h2][list][*][p]Characters can now sit in chairs[/p][/*][*][p]Characters can perform emotes while sitting and push to nudge the chair around[/p][/*][*][p]Items are dropped when sitting in a chair[/p][/*][*][p]Improved chair cloth physics[/p][/*][*][p]Chair cloth physics now interact with the ground[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Spring Boards[/h2][list][*][p]Added the spring board, a flexible and bouncy board for jumping[/p][/*][*][p]Spring boards adjust your jump height, time your jumps with the board moving up to gain extra height[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Umbrellas[/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted the collision for beach umbrellas, removing the bump on top from the pole[/p][/*][*][p]Umbrella cloth physics now interacts with the character[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Windsocks[/h2][list][*][p]Added new windsocks with interactive physics[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Water Balloons[/h2][list][*][p]Arms of water balloons wave around while they're carried, no more eye covering[/p][/*][*][p]Water balloons now pop more easily when thrown at characters[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Characters[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could get locked out of stowing or drawing items[/p][/*][*][p]Added Spin animations for holding water cannon and water balloon[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the stow/draw animation to work better with frisbees[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hairs not casting shadows[/p][/*][*][p]Look at system is now calculated on the client-side and replicated to all other players (was calculated on the server-side)[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled aiming while rope-walking (this may be re-implemented later)[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented animations for rope walking while holding a water cannon or water balloon[/p][/*][*][p]Rope walking movement is now faster[/p][/*][*][p]Rope walking leaning wobble animation now works while moving, previously it only worked when standing still[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed characters not looking at water balloons and air balloons[/p][/*][*][p]Characters now pop water balloons when belly flopping onto them[/p][/*][*][p]Removed automatic expression change when flopping from a dive[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where transitions from shorter movement states to taller movement states would strongly push down the object you were standing on[/p][/*][*][p]Idle animation is now blended into other actions such as pushing, picking up, running, jumping, and emotes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed movement animation physics, this fixes the amount of leaning back while running and performing actions like pushing or grabbing/picking up[/p][/*][*][p]Increased smoothness in the character's yaw rotation when jumping into and colliding with a surface[/p][/*][*][p]Added a waiting animation that plays when laying on the ground[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hair not squashing and stretching properly[/p][/*][*][p]Improved hair physics[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed two issues with clinging onto ropes, involving replication and other players clinging incorrectly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed push vfx only appearing for the local player, now all players will see it[/p][/*][*][p]Added a jump start animation for spinning[/p][/*][*][p]Improved jumping animations[/p][/*][*][p]Improved animation for shove and pick up actions while running[/p][/*][*][p]After shoving or grabbing in the air, animations will change to hands in front instead of back up high[/p][/*][*][p]Added a tiny jiggle to the character's head when jumping or pushing repeatedly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where getting wet would require you to press the Change Expression input twice for it to take effect, or wait 3 seconds for it to apply[/p][/*][*][p]Wetness changes now apply a new expression every 3 seconds and allow you to use the Change Expression input at any time[/p][/*][*][p]Characters now have a smaller "perch" radius, related to how far they can walk off an object before falling off[/p][/*][*][p]When jumping onto an object just outside their "perch" radius, characters will automatically correct their position towards the object[/p][/*][*][p]Inherited velocity and angular velocity from objects stood on by the player when entering a jump is now tweaked on a per object basis[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the water breaching animation was not playing the shove animation when shoving[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Physics[/h2][list][*][p]Characters now inherit yaw rotation from the object they're standing on[/p][/*][*][p]When a character pushes, they create a backwards force on the object they're standing on[/p][/*][*][p]Firing a water cannon now imparts an opposing force on the object that the character is standing on[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the resistance in the joint for the lever style water obstacle[/p][/*][*][p]Push force has been adjusted for water balloons, open-top crates, and closed crates[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Sound[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed sound attenuation and effects volume setting not applying for stone and wood jump and land sound effects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sound attenuation for throw and pick up sound effect[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]UI[/h2][list][*][p]Updated cursors[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Reset button in Settings, it resets all settings and input bindings to default, sets window mode to windowed, and sets resolution to a small resolution[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Reset button in Game settings, it resets all game settings (num rounds, round time, players to start) to default[/p][/*][*][p]Added functionality to the in-game player list, you can now mute yourself and other players while in-game[/p][/*][*][p]Player list now shows behind the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Merged the Start button with the progress bar in the lobby UI[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the character outline in the portrait, it now shows when hovering the character in the lobby[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Misc.[/h2][list][*][p]Changed visuals for the ocean, removing the white wave crests[/p][/*][*][p]Window mode and resolution settings now update whenever the game window is resized[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with switching between displays of different resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly changed the volcano mesh and added a shadow to the mouth[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly decreased size of the frisbee[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the inflatable R model in the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Camera mode (close, medium, and far) is now saved between games and sessions[/p][/*][*][p]Default camera mode changed from medium to far[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted default master volume to 50%[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Playtest Version 7 Changelog
notes.notes:
- Fixed hiding gameplay UI
- Fixed buoyancy for the beach ball
- Fixed footprints not resetting correctly between rounds for non-host players
- Steam names now show when hovering your cursor on character portraits
- Outgoing voice volume setting was not initialized correctly from the settings save file
- Added an Audio setting for voice sensitivity
- Lowered the default voice sensitivity value, microphones now pick up sound more easily
- Increased the volume of voice chat
- Fixed characters getting stuck in spin state if soaked during a spin
- Returning to the lobby with Lobby button now stops existing music
- Changing expression now always picks a new expression
- Adjusted tower impacts, it's now easier to push over
- 25-30% cpu side performance increase from optimization of buoyancy and ropes
- Removed ping from the join menu
- Ping is now shown in the top right while in-game, can be disabled in settings
- FPS is now shown in the top right, can be disabled in the settings
- Characters now spawn facing the intended direction
- Removed start button in the lobby for non-hosting players
- Character now enter soaked animations without an intro animation after climbing
- Errors are now shown correctly on the Main Menu after you are removed from a game due to an error
- Added an input prompt to show the player list during gameplay
- Reduced network traffic for the tower
- Testing a fix for objects not attaching to hands correctly for clients with very high ping
- Testing a fix for other player characters jittering while standing on moving surfaces
- Spinning inputs are now disabled while aiming, fixing an issue where the character would stop facing the camera while aiming
- Removed ue4 prerequisites installer, prerequisites are now handled by steam
- Fixed a one-frame jitter in the character animation when transitioning between jump and walking states
- Added squash and stretch to character jump animations
- Fixed a desync issue with the flight paths for balloons, causing a client-side jitter for the balloon platforms
- Added placeholder mouse cursors
- Items and stowed items are now dropped if a player character leaves a game in progress
- Added camera angles that better show your character when spawning into a game
- Fixed an occlusion culling issue for boxes
- Fixed leaning issues when a player character starts moving on top of an object and when landing a jump
- Fixed an issue with swim stroke state spinning or not applying force in the right direction
- Fixed an issue with disc-character collision after the disc had been thrown
- Fixed an issue with water balloons sometimes colliding briefly with the character when thrown
- Fixed the window mode and resolution settings not updating color until closing and opening the settings menu
- Optimized performance of balloon animations
- Fixed rope walking not appearing correctly on other player characters for non-hosting players
- Fixed character portrait eyes potentially being stuck looking in the wrong direction after the game starts
- Fixed an issue with the character portrait hair physics
- Added the expression input prompt to the lobby UI
- Moved input prompts to the bottom left for the lobby UI
- Fixed the Voip system not working when joining a game unless you already started a session
- Fixed stars still appearing on portraits after players have left a game
